draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.92, the 178th-best grade among 261 2022 draftees and 11th of 18 at TE. He went 177th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 42 receiving yards in 2021, 19th of 19 TEs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 5 pro, currently with the Dallas Cowboys (practice squad). 35 career games and 1 starts over 4 completed seasons. Trending down from his peak: 0 AV in 2025 against a career-best 1 in 2022. Weak spots: team target share 0.6% (8th percentile), approximate value 0 (9th percentile). Played 5 of 17 games in 2025. Versus the typical Year-4 tight end who played: 28 receiving yards against a median of 179, below the norm.
